question: Should Discord Activities support be revived by porting this draft into the current Discord and Canvas plugin contracts, or should maintainers replace it with the newer Activities branch?
rationale: The code direction changes Gateway auth, public A2UI exposure, and plugin config ownership, so the permanent security/config contract needs maintainer intent before automation rewrites the branch.

options.title: Port and harden this draft
options.body: Move the Discord changes into `extensions/discord`, put Activity config under Canvas plugin config, require a non-URL launch-scoped credential, and bound the bridge before review resumes.

options.title: Use the newer Activities branch
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/65205 as the replacement direction if maintainers prefer its broader launch-context and setup work.

options.title: Pause Activity core work
options.body: Keep Activity support out of core until the Canvas/Discord plugin API and security model are explicitly designed.

recommendation.title: Port and harden this draft
recommendation.body: Move the Discord changes into `extensions/discord`, put Activity config under Canvas plugin config, require a non-URL launch-scoped credential, and bound the bridge before review resumes.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current Activity proposal and have recent merged history on the Discord component surface.
